intendedUse: Research-only demonstration of a structured-feature classifier against the UCI Cleveland cohort. Decision-support prototyping only.
outOfScope: Any prediction outside the 13 recorded features
Use with real patient identifiers in production

preprocessing.numeric: z-score fitted on the training partition only
preprocessing.categorical: one-hot with fixed category orders; categories forward-mapped by the API contract (see cardiac.ts)
preprocessing.missingValues: rows with missing ca/thal dropped (n=303 -> n=297); the API rejects missing inputs rather than imputing

datasetProvenance.licenseNote: UCI Machine Learning Repository terms; research use. Not redistribution-approved for clinical purposes.

trainingConfig.noLeakage: preprocessing fitted on train partition only; test partition untouched until final evaluation

knownLimitations: Small historical cohort (297 usable records from 1988 Cleveland); not representative of current or any local populations.
Public benchmark dataset; a held-out score here is not clinical validation.
Scores are uncalibrated logistic outputs, not probabilities of disease for an individual.
No subgroup fairness analyses were performed; therefore fairness across demographic groups is unverified.

inferenceNote: Serve only as clearly-labelled research output; never as clinical risk.
